decisive_items: a right breast mass noted for more than 1 year
response.rationale: R5 is the most specific diagnosis given the combination of a long-standing breast mass, recent skin ulceration, and imaging findings suggestive of malignancy, whereas R3 is a more general diagnosis of breast cancer.

rejected.why: while skin ulceration is a characteristic feature, the overall clinical presentation and imaging findings are more suggestive of invasive breast cancer
Paget's disease of the breast typically presents with eczematous changes of the nipple and areola, which is not described in the vignette
the absence of elevated serum breast tumor markers is not specific enough to suggest triple-negative breast cancer
it is an append-only completion and not a distinct diagnosis
